reproduces: Workday Education: year-only date widgets whose own label is just 'Year' and whose question ('From', 'To (actual or expected)') lives only in the container text.
reconstructed: Only the two year inputs are quoted from GET /api/autofill/telemetry/summary. School, Degree and Field of Study are reconstructed from Workday's naming convention; they are here as positive controls, because they are the fields in this block that today's rules already fill, so a characterisation change in them is a change Task 8 did not intend. No month sibling is included: Workday's education dates are year-only, which is exactly what the two signatures show (datesectionyear with no datesectionmonth alongside), and inventing one would let Task 8 solve a problem this page does not pose.
